name: @agentina/aotui-terminal
description: AOTUI Terminal Application - Multi-terminal command execution for LLM workflows

aotui.whatItIs: A multi-terminal shell application with command history, working directory tracking, and output tailing for LLM workflows.
aotui.whenToUse: Run shell commands in the project workspace, manage terminal sessions, and inspect command status and output.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && generate-aoapp .
